title: ICPC Awards
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: A contest scoreboard lists up to two hundred teams in finishing order, each line giving the team's university and its name. Only the highest-placed team of any university may win a prize, and exactly twelve prizes are handed out. The task is to print the twelve prize-winning teams, in scoreboard order, given that at least twelve distinct universities appear.
